tankArchitectures.name: Heavy-Duty Multi-Frequency Ultrasonic Immersion Tank (25/40 kHz Dual Sweep, Submerged Transducer Packs)
tankArchitectures.classification: Industrial Commercial Dishwashing & Cookware Fabrication (NSF/ANSI Standard 3, IEC 61161 & NFPA 79)
tankArchitectures.metallurgy: 316L Heavy-Gauge Stainless Steel (Electropolished Ra ≤ 0.5 µm, ASTM A967 Passivated)
tankArchitectures.transducerMounting: Vacuum-Degassed Structural Aerospace Epoxy with Precision Stainless Stud Anchors
tankArchitectures.transducerType: Langevin PZT-8 High-Power Piezoelectric Sandwich (36 × 50W Elements)
tankArchitectures.description: Industrial scullery and commercial cookware manufacturing ultrasonic degreaser engineered to strip polymerized carbonized oils, grease binders, and buffing compounds from heavy cast iron, stainless, and aluminum pans prior to final sanitizing. Utilizes digital frequency sweep modulation to eliminate acoustic standing wave dead-zones and dissipate concentrated cavitation erosion.

tankArchitectures.name: Compact Commercial Scullery Benchtop Ultrasonic Wash Tank (40 kHz Fixed Frequency, Direct Bottom Bond)
tankArchitectures.classification: Commercial Kitchen Utensil & Cutlery Sanitize Pre-Wash (NSF/ANSI Standard 169 & UL 921)
tankArchitectures.metallurgy: 304 Food-Grade Stainless Steel (Brushed Finish Ra ≈ 0.8 µm)
tankArchitectures.transducerMounting: Single-Part Heat-Cured Epoxy Adhesion (Direct Basin Underside Bonding Without Studs)
tankArchitectures.description: Widely deployed in restaurant sculleries and bakeries for removing stubborn baked-on starch, protein films, and utensil crevices. Lacking frequency sweep, intense standing waves create localized erosion hotspots directly above transducer centers, accelerating basin pitting under prolonged high-temperature cycles.

tankArchitectures.name: High-Frequency Precision Cookware Finishing & Anodizing Tank (80/130 kHz Megasonic Transition Bath)
tankArchitectures.classification: High-End Anodized Cookware & Medical Kitchenware Finishing (ISO 14644-1 & ASTM F312)
tankArchitectures.metallurgy: Electropolished 316L Stainless Steel (Ra ≤ 0.3 µm, Vacuum-Annealed Stress-Relieved)
tankArchitectures.transducerMounting: Direct Active-Brazed Ceramic-to-Metal Interface (Zero Epoxy Creep or Delamination)
tankArchitectures.transducerType: High-Frequency Multi-Element Piezoelectric Ceramic Arrays (24 × 50W Elements)
tankArchitectures.description: Precision ultrasonic finishing line for hard-anodized aluminum cookware, nonstick pan substrate micro-etching, and laser-welded kitchen cutlery. High frequency yields gentle sub-micron cavitation (~10–20 µm bubbles) that dislodges sub-micron polishing rouge without base metal erosion or transducer delamination.

tankArchitectures.name: Degraded Field-Service Degreaser (Delaminated Transducers, Pitted Basin, Severe Acoustic Cavitation Wear)
tankArchitectures.classification: Compromised Commercial Scullery Operation (Erosion Perforation & Shock Hazard Risk)
tankArchitectures.metallurgy: Heavily Pitted 304 Stainless Steel with Micro-Cracks and Cavitation Pitting (ASTM G32 Mass Loss)
tankArchitectures.transducerMounting: Degraded Thermal Epoxy with Acoustic Air Gap Voids and Resonant Shear Fracture (40% Detached)
tankArchitectures.transducerType: Aged PZT-4 Ceramic Discs with Resonant Frequency Shift and Dielectric Breakdown
tankArchitectures.description: End-of-life scullery wash tank operated beyond recommended maintenance intervals. Cavitation erosion has formed deep pinhole pits in the basin bottom, while thermal cycling has fractured transducer epoxy bonds, causing severe reflected electrical power, localized acoustic dead zones, and imminent tank wall perforation.

cleaningChemistries.name: Heavy-Duty Alkaline Caustic Degreaser (3-5% NaOH/KOH, Silicates, pH 13.2)
cleaningChemistries.classification: Industrial Cast Iron & Stainless Cookware Stripping (Not Aluminum Safe)
cleaningChemistries.description: High caustic alkalinity rapidly saponifies triglycerides and breaks down carbonized polymerized oil films on cast iron and heavy stainless steel pans. High surface tension generates energetic Rayleigh-Plesset cavitation collapse shockwaves (>1,800 bar), but strongly accelerates intergranular stress corrosion inside basin cavitation micro-pits.

cleaningChemistries.name: Mild Alkaline Silicated Cleaner (Potassium Silicate & Non-Ionic Surfactants, pH 10.8)
cleaningChemistries.classification: Commercial All-Metal Kitchen Safe Degreasing (Aluminum & Cookware Safe)
cleaningChemistries.description: Balanced formulation suitable for mixed commercial kitchen sculleries containing aluminum sheet pans, brass fittings, and stainless pots. Silicate inhibitors deposit an instantaneous monomolecular passivating barrier that protects soft alloys while surfactant chemistry reduces cavitation inception threshold.

cleaningChemistries.name: Neutral Multi-Enzyme Aqueous Cleaner (Protease/Amylase with Bio-Surfactants, pH 7.4)
cleaningChemistries.classification: Sensitive Coated Bakeware, Nonstick Pans & Cutlery Cleaning
cleaningChemistries.description: Enzymatically digests baked starch and denatured protein biofilms without aggressive chemical attack. Low surface tension promotes dense, high-frequency micro-bubble clouds that gently scrub delicate nonstick fluoropolymer and ceramic coatings without interfacial bond shearing.

cleaningChemistries.name: Mild Organic Acidic Descaler (10% Citric & Phosphoric Acid Blend, pH 2.6)
cleaningChemistries.classification: Commercial Bain-Marie, Kettle & Steam Table Scale Removal
cleaningChemistries.description: Dissolves stubborn calcium carbonate, hard water scale, and mineral beerstone. The acidic chemistry actively dissolves passive chromium oxide films on 304 stainless basins, creating aggressive erosion-corrosion synergy that accelerates cavitation pitting during descaling cycles.

targetMaterials.name: Commercial 316L Heavy Stainless Steel Cookware & Hotel Pans
targetMaterials.description: High molybdenum content (2.0–2.5%) provides outstanding resistance to both cavitation micro-jet water hammer and chloride-induced pitting corrosion. Ideal substrate for intensive scullery wash operations.

targetMaterials.name: Commercial 304 Standard Stainless Steel Cookware & Steam Table Inserts
targetMaterials.description: Industry standard scullery metal. Lacks molybdenum, making it susceptible to micro-pitting in high-chloride or acidic cavitation zones. Under continuous violent cavitation, surface austenite undergoes localized transformation to brittle martensite.

targetMaterials.name: Heavy-Duty Sheet Pan Aluminum (Al-Mg 5052-H32 Alloy)
targetMaterials.delaminationSensitivity: Severe (Rapid Surface Pitting within 15 mins at 25 kHz)
targetMaterials.description: Low hardness makes commercial aluminum highly vulnerable to plastic deformation from acoustic cavitation shockwaves. Exposure to 25 kHz violent cavitation produces visible pinhole etching, surface frost, and metal loss in less than 20 minutes.

targetMaterials.name: Multi-Layer PTFE Fluoropolymer or Sol-Gel Ceramic Nonstick Fry Pan
targetMaterials.description: Micro-jets penetrate coating micropores, generating localized hydraulic pressure beneath the nonstick primer layer. Intense ultrasonic cavitation strips nonstick coatings via acoustic interfacial blistering and shear delamination.
